- [LSCO.8.2] **The reference runtime is the native C Rete engine.**
  The language spec abstracts over Rete semantics so the contract stays
  stable while the runtime evolves. DS ships one runtime; integrators
  take it as-is and build platforms around it. Shaping the runtime to a
  specific platform is a first-class concern ([LDIA]).
  Restates [LSCO.4.1].
gap_reason: The tie is DOCUMENTARY, not verifying. The fixture is a deprecated placeholder that compiles one schema and cannot fail. The clause states what the reference runtime is, which no vector drives. The tie is kept because spec_crossref seeds conformance from the fixture-name convention and would re-add it; the gap is asserted so the clause reads honestly in the coverage report. As for LCON.6.
